risks.title: Merger Failure or Delay
risks.score_rationale: The Merger is a critical event for the company, and its failure or delay could have severe consequences. The company has already incurred significant costs preparing for the Merger and faces operational restrictions during the transition period.

risks.title: Cyberattacks and Security Breaches
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to risks of cyberattacks and security disruptions, which could result in financial losses, reputational damage, and customer data compromise.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive semiconductor and wireless technology market, where new entrants and established players create constant pressure on pricing and market share.

risks.title: Supply Chain Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on suppliers for the production of key components and finished products. Supply chain disruptions could reduce production capacity and impact delivery timelines.

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations across multiple jurisdictions. Changes in regulation, including safety standards and export restrictions, could affect profitability.

risks.title: Dependence on Proprietary Technologies
risks.score_rationale: The company heavily relies on its proprietary technologies and product development capabilities. Technological failures or obsolescence could impair its competitiveness.

risks.title: Reputation and Customer Relationship Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company faces reputational risks in the event of quality issues, cyberattacks, or operational disruptions that could undermine customer and partner trust.
